name: Platinum Vape | 1g 510 Live Resin | Blackberry Kush
description:
Blackberry Kush by Platinum Vape is compatible with 510 Thread Cartridge, has 1g of THC dominant cannabis deprived live resin. 

Platinum Vape only uses the best ingredients nature has to offer in each cartridge, by extracting top-quality cannabis oil from a pesticide-free, high-potency harvest of the finest cannabis flowers. 

PV 1g LR C-Cell - Blackberry Kush is made of an Indica blend, has the taste profile of Citrus, Orange, Lemon, and offers consumers feelings of Relaxed, Sleepy, Happy, Euphoric, Hungry.
